---
name: Task
about: A change specified well enough that a cloud session can work it with no other context
---

## Why

What is wrong or missing today, and who it affects.

## Change

What changes, file by file where it matters. Name the rule, section or script, not a line number.

## Done when

The checks that prove it: tests, evals, a command and its expected output.

## Out of scope

What this issue does not cover, with the issue that does where there is one.
